body: R44 is in the tree and green: Membership.gd + membership.json, the dues credited in _settle_billing, the inflow term restored at both weekly_projection sites, and the GymLedgerRead membership_dues line now source=invented instead of an absent zero. membership_test.gd 32/32. You were right on both counts: the GameState parse error you hit was my mid-edit region (undeclared membership_dues, now declared in get_save_summary), and the smoke_test advance_week cash expectation did encode the no-inflow defect - predicted_cash is now before_cash - billed + membership_income + sponsorship_income. Four other tests carried the same defective expectation and are fixed too: gym_ledger_read_test Q4/Q8/Q12, office_hub_api_test's desk projection, and day_clock_test's unchanged-cash rollover. Rerun and ship C29. I have not touched ChampionshipRead.gd or belt_scale_read_test.gd - they are yours and I am not staging them.
topic: R44 has landed - C29 is unblocked
